quality.title: Quality Control & Logistics
quality.description: 24-48H dispatch from Linyi warehouse. Sea freight via Qingdao Port, or land freight by truck or rail. Destination and ETA confirmed on inquiry.
quality.h1: Trust in Every Component. Direct OEM Quality.
quality.intro: From raw material to final dispatch, Linyi Songyu guarantees precision. Our integrated supply chain ensures fleets in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa receive rigorously tested parts, faster.
quality.protocolDesc: Critical transmission and brake parts are checked for dimensions before dispatch. Dynamic balancing and pressure tests are used where the part requires it. Shipments follow the part number.
quality.card1Desc: High-speed rotational testing to ensure perfect equilibrium, reducing wear and vibration.
quality.card2Desc: Hydraulic and pneumatic integrity checks for transmission housings and brake calipers.
quality.card3Desc: Multi-point visual and laser-scanned dimensional checks against OEM specifications.
quality.hubDesc: Linyi is China’s logistics capital. High-wear parts are stocked locally, leave the warehouse in 24–48 hours, then move by sea via Qingdao or by land freight. Routing confirmed on inquiry.
quality.shipDesc: Standard orders processed, crated, and ready for transit within 48 hours.
quality.portDesc: After warehouse release, cargo moves overland to Qingdao Port for loading. Heavy parts such as transmissions, main drives, and differentials go by sea.
quality.consolDesc: Transmissions, brakes, and radiators can ship together. LCL or FCL lowers per-order ocean cost for regional buyers.
quality.destDesc: Typical sea and inland destinations in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Sailings, land routing, container type, and ETA are confirmed on inquiry.
quality.seaLead: Warehouse release and ocean transit are stated separately: Linyi handles stock and stuffing; Qingdao handles export loading on the terms in your quote.
quality.sea1Desc: Part-number check, export packing, and crating. In-stock orders are ready within 48 hours.
quality.sea2Desc: Cargo moves from Linyi to Qingdao Port for export loading. Heavy parts go by sea.
quality.sea3Desc: LCL or FCL to major ports. Destination clearance follows the Incoterms on your quote.
quality.ctaTitle: Need a part-number match or a dispatch quote?
quality.ctaDesc: Upload a photo of your broken part's nameplate or enter your VIN. Our team will provide a rapid match and quote.
quality.landDesc: After warehouse release, cargo can move by truck or rail. Border, routing, and transit time are confirmed on inquiry. No fixed ETA is published.
quality.landLead: Warehouse release and overland transit are stated separately: Linyi handles stock and packing; land pickup or rail handover follows the terms in your quote.
quality.land1Desc: Part-number check, export packing, and crating. In-stock orders are ready within 48 hours.
quality.land2Desc: Cargo leaves Linyi by truck or rail. Mode, border, and routing are confirmed on the RFQ—not as a published timetable.
quality.land3Desc: Destination clearance follows the Incoterms on your quote.

about.title: About Us
about.description: OEM-compatible construction machinery parts from Linyi. Part-number fitment, Linyi stock, customs and sea freight via Qingdao for mines and fleets in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
about.lead: Specialist export supply for construction machinery and heavy equipment. OEM-compatible parts and one-stop sourcing for mining projects, contractors, and transport fleets in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
about.what: Match by part number and technical drawings to the machine model, so the wrong part does not extend downtime.
about.where: Based in Linyi, with high-wear parts and powertrain assemblies in stock, picked and staged to order.
about.how: Customs, LCL, and FCL via Qingdao Port. Sailings, routing, and container type are confirmed on inquiry.
about.close: Quality first, accurate dispatch, global service. Long-term supply for overseas mines and heavy fleets. Sales replies on inquiry.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.description: Dispatch from Linyi, sea freight via Qingdao or land freight. Sailings, container type, and charges are confirmed on inquiry.
shipping.lead: Warehouse release, packing, and transit are stated separately on the quote. The notes below are typical; the confirmed quote governs.
shipping.s1Body: Parts are checked by part number, picked, and packed in Linyi. In-stock items are released to the inquiry.
shipping.s2Body: Export customs and stuffing via Qingdao Port, LCL or FCL. Destination, container type, and sailing are confirmed on inquiry.
shipping.s3Body: After release, truck or rail can be arranged. Routing and handover are confirmed on inquiry.
shipping.s4Body: Freight, insurance, and clearance follow the trade terms on the quote. This site does not publish a rate sheet.

payment.title: Payment policy
payment.description: Payment is agreed on the quote. Linyi Songyu does not post bank details on this website.
payment.lead: Method, currency, and schedule are agreed after the quote is confirmed.
payment.s1Body: Talk to sales on WhatsApp, phone, or email. Payment terms are written on the quote.
payment.s2Body: Bank details are sent only on a formal quote or written confirmation. Do not pay unknown accounts claiming to be Songyu.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Linyi Songyu uses inquiry contacts and part numbers.
privacy.lead: Information sent with an RFQ is used to quote and follow up. It is not sold.
privacy.s1Body: An inquiry may include part numbers, machine model, quantity, contact details, and nameplate photos or videos you send.
privacy.s2Body: We use it to match parts, reply with a quote, and continue the conversation. A language cookie may be stored in the browser.
privacy.s3Body: WhatsApp, phone, and email run under their providers’ rules. We do not sell inquiry lists.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: Terms for using the Linyi Songyu catalog, RFQ, and quotes.
terms.lead: This site shows parts and receives inquiries. A sale follows the quote both sides confirm.
terms.s1Body: Product pages are for inquiry. Specs follow the part number and written confirmation. OEM-compatible is not genuine OEM.
terms.s2Body: An RFQ is not an order. Price, quantity, lead time, and freight follow the quote confirmed by sales.
terms.s3Body: Photos and videos help identify the model. The agreed specification governs the goods.
terms.s4Body: Using this site means you accept these notes. Disputes are discussed first. The laws of the People’s Republic of China apply.
